```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(knitr)
library(DT)
library(plotly)
library(ggplot2)

contrast <- params$contrast
group    <- params$group
```

## Contrast: `r contrast`

```{r load, include=FALSE}
de <- tryCatch(
  read_tsv(params$de_summary, show_col_types = FALSE),
  error = function(e) NULL
)
de_ct <- if (!is.null(de) && "contrast" %in% colnames(de)) {
  filter(de, contrast == !!contrast)
} else { de }

cis <- tryCatch(read_tsv(params$cis_pairs, show_col_types = FALSE),
                error = function(e) NULL)
cis_sig <- tryCatch(read_tsv(params$cis_pairs_sig, show_col_types = FALSE),
                    error = function(e) NULL)
ora <- tryCatch(read_tsv(params$ora, show_col_types = FALSE),
                error = function(e) NULL)
gsea <- tryCatch(read_tsv(params$gsea, show_col_types = FALSE),
                 error = function(e) NULL)
```

## DE summary

```{r de-summary}
if (!is.null(de_ct) && nrow(de_ct) > 0) {
  n_sig <- sum(de_ct$padj < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)
  n_up  <- sum(de_ct$padj < 0.05 & de_ct$log2FoldChange > 0, na.rm = TRUE)
  n_dn  <- sum(de_ct$padj < 0.05 & de_ct$log2FoldChange < 0, na.rm = TRUE)
  kable(data.frame(
    genes_tested = nrow(de_ct),
    significant_padj_0.05 = n_sig,
    up = n_up, down = n_dn
  ), format = "html")
} else {
  cat("No differential expression results for this contrast.")
}
```

### Volcano plot

```{r volcano}
if (!is.null(de_ct) && nrow(de_ct) > 0 &&
    all(c("log2FoldChange", "pvalue") %in% colnames(de_ct))) {
  de_ct <- de_ct %>% mutate(
    sig = ifelse(!is.na(padj) & padj < 0.05, "FDR<0.05", "ns"),
    logp = -log10(pvalue)
  )
  p <- ggplot(de_ct, aes(log2FoldChange, logp, color = sig)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 1.2) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("FDR<0.05" = "#d62728", "ns" = "#7f7f7f")) +
    labs(color = "Significance") +
    theme_minimal()
  print(p)
} else {
  cat("Insufficient data for volcano plot.")
}
```

### Table

```{r de-table}
if (!is.null(de_ct) && nrow(de_ct) > 0) {
  tab <- de_ct %>%
    select(any_of(c("gene_id", "baseMean", "log2FoldChange", "lfcSE",
                    "pvalue", "padj"))) %>%
    arrange(padj)
  datatable(tab, filter = "top", options = list(pageLength = 20))
} else {
  cat("No DE data.")
}
```

## Cis-regulatory associations

```{r cis}
if (!is.null(cis_sig) && nrow(cis_sig) > 0) {
  cat("**Significant cis pairs:**\n")
  datatable(cis_sig, options = list(pageLength = 20))
} else {
  cat("No significant cis-regulatory associations for this contrast.")
}
```
